name: SteeringAgent
src_typeComment: Ready-to-drop-in mover built on SteeringBehaviors — set a mode and (for Seek/Flee/Arrive) a target, and this handles velocity integration and facing rotation for you. Moves the transform directly (no Rigidbody needed), matching the rest of the toolkit's kinematic-movement style.

src_serialized.name: mode
src_serialized.tooltip: Which SteeringBehaviors formula drives this agent.

src_serialized.name: target
src_serialized.tooltip: Required for Seek/Flee/Arrive. Ignored for Wander.

src_serialized.name: maxForce
src_serialized.tooltip: Maximum steering force applied per second — lower values turn/accelerate more sluggishly.

src_serialized.name: arriveSlowRadius
src_serialized.tooltip: Arrive mode only: distance from the target at which the agent starts slowing down.

src_serialized.name: faceMovementDirection
src_serialized.tooltip: Rotates the agent to face its movement direction.

src_serialized.name: flockNeighborRadius
src_serialized.tooltip: Other SteeringAgents within this radius are treated as flockmates. Flocking agents need a Collider (a trigger works fine) for this radius check to find them.

src_serialized.name: separationWeight
src_serialized.tooltip: How strongly this agent pushes away from flockmates that get too close.

src_serialized.name: alignmentWeight
src_serialized.tooltip: How strongly this agent tries to match its flockmates' average heading.

src_serialized.name: cohesionWeight
src_serialized.tooltip: How strongly this agent drifts toward its flockmates' average position.

src_members.sig: public Vector3 Velocity { get; private set; }
src_members.name: Velocity

src_members.sig: public void SetTarget(Transform newTarget) => target = newTarget
src_members.name: SetTarget

src_members.sig: public void SetMode(SteeringMode newMode) => mode = newMode
src_members.name: SetMode
